name: tell_me
title: Section C · an agent's run stays out of the stream, until the person asks to be told

steps.result: This is my first run, and there are **2 listings**: Harbour Car Wash and Corner Print Shop.

steps.say: From now on, tell me here whenever Listing Watch finds a new listing.
steps.reply:
Done. From now on, every time Listing Watch runs, it will tell you here which listings are new.

It checks every Monday at 09:00 (or when your Mac next wakes, if it was asleep then), so the next check is Monday 26 October. Its first run today found 2 listings: Harbour Car Wash and Corner Print Shop. Anything that shows up after those will be reported here.

If you want to hear about a new listing as soon as it's added, not just on Mondays, I can make it check whenever a listing is added too. And if you ever want the updates to stop, just say so.

steps.result: One new listing since my last run: **Lakeside Bakery**, asking $450,000.

steps.say: Stop telling me about Listing Watch.
steps.reply:
Done. Listing Watch won't report here anymore. It still checks every Monday at 09:00, and you can see its findings on its page.

One thing came in just before you asked: its latest check found a new listing, **Lakeside Bakery**, asking $450,000.

steps.result: One new listing since my last run: **Sunbelt Laundry**.
